visual_hierarchy.why: A ranks five equal cards and a secondary Load; B creates one dominant action with status adjacent.

density_rhythm.why: Both share the card grid; B adds a footer band whose left edge is off the form column.

state_coverage.why: A's active state is identical to idle and the error lives in the wrong card; B differentiates all six in one place.

accessibility.why: Both label fields and show a focus ring; B adds text to every status, both keep the detached 13 px checkbox.

consistency.why: A splits status across header and card; B consolidates it into one pill.

polish.why: A cuts the page mid-textarea; B's footer button is out of line with the cards and the error line hugs the bottom.
